presentation.label: 256 project Kits
presentation.summary: Replace 64 bank-tied Parts with 256 Kits shared across a project. Load, save, reload and copy Kits independently of banks.
presentation.overview: Em's Octakit replaces the Octatrack's Parts with project-wide Kits. It adds LOAD KIT and SAVE KIT menus, seven-character names, Kit slot copy/paste/clear/undo and pattern workflows that copy the assigned Kit. Old projects migrate their Parts into the first 64 Kit slots. Back up projects before using a qualified build: returning to stock may lose Kit data. This Octamod import remains a draft awaiting review and qualification.
highlights: 256 Kits per project, independent of banks.
LOAD KIT, SAVE KIT and immediate reload of the assigned Kit.
Kit names, slot copy/paste/clear/undo and UNDO KIT for the last loaded Kit.
Copy a pattern with its Kit into the next available slots.
Automatic migration of old project Parts into the first 64 Kit slots.
usage: On MKII, press PART for LOAD KIT or FUNC+PART for SAVE KIT.
On MKI, use FUNC+MIDI for LOAD KIT or FUNC+BANK for SAVE KIT.
Use FUNC+CUE to reload the assigned Kit.
Back up projects and work on a disposable copy during qualification.

access.location: LOAD KIT and SAVE KIT replace the Part menus: MKII PART / FUNC+PART; MKI FUNC+MIDI / FUNC+BANK.
steps: Back up the project before opening it in an OctaKit build; old Parts migrate to Kits and returning to stock may lose Kit data.
On MKII, press PART to open LOAD KIT. On MKI, hold FUNC and press MIDI.
Choose a Kit slot and press YES to load it. LOAD KIT > UNDO KIT recalls the last loaded Kit.
On MKII, hold FUNC and press PART to open SAVE KIT. On MKI, hold FUNC and press BANK.
Choose a slot, confirm and enter a name of up to seven characters. FUNC+PART+YES on MKII, or FUNC+BANK+YES on MKI, skips the name prompt.
Hold FUNC and press CUE to reload the assigned Kit.
In LOAD KIT or SAVE KIT, use copy/paste/clear/undo to manage Kit slots.
When pasting a pattern, FUNC+PASTE+PART on MKII or FUNC+PASTE+MIDI on MKI also saves its assigned Kit to the next available slot.
PTN+FUNC+RIGHT saves the current Kit, copies it and the pattern to the next available slots, then loads the new pair.
PTN+FUNC+TRIG manages inactive patterns. For other banks, use BANK+TRIG followed by BANK+FUNC+TRIG.

limitations: Draft only: unavailable in the configurator until required evidence and owner approval are complete.
Backup required: old projects migrate from Parts to Kits; downgrading to stock may lose Kit data.
Upstream reports a 3.6% reduction of the Flex pool: 18.4 seconds at 16-bit or 12.3 seconds at 24-bit.
No DSP algorithm or effect slot; the runtime changes ColdFire project, Part and Kit behavior.
Octamod combinations, including MIDI Scenes and Scale Quantizer, are unverified. Native hook and arena collisions must be rejected or resolved by reviewed integration.
Upstream leaves dirty marking, UNDO KIT and pattern-paste behavior after external parameter writes open. Historical hardware notes do not qualify this version.

storage.label: Audio arena reservation
storage.conditions: Upstream reserves 528 shared audio pages of 6,144 bytes at 0x45d0dde0..0x46025de0 for runtime, Kit store and backup. This is an arena claim only: temporary boot staging, stock memory reuse, stack, packing, peak lifetimes and complete totals still require an exact reviewed memory report.

processing.label: ColdFire processing
processing.conditions: No worst-case ColdFire event counts or real-time budgets covering Kit load/save, migration, parameter modulation, mode changes, persistence and maximum audio/MIDI/USB load were supplied for this Octamod version.

tests.summary: Pinned upstream records standalone image identity, emulator boot and historical hardware use. No Octamod native/browser parity, current-version worst-case cycles, complete memory inventory, 60-minute eight-track hardware stress record or actual LCD captures are supplied.
